modelAnswer.en:
DECLARE Line, Code, Description, QuantityText : STRING
DECLARE Quantity, LowCount : INTEGER
LowCount ← 0
OPENFILE "Stock.csv" FOR READ
OPENFILE "LowStock.txt" FOR WRITE
WHILE NOT EOF("Stock.csv")
   READFILE "Stock.csv", Line
   Code ← FIELD(Line, 1)
   Description ← FIELD(Line, 2)
   QuantityText ← FIELD(Line, 3)
   // The supplied TOINTEGER routine reports an error for malformed input.
   IF Code = "" OR Description = "" THEN
      OUTPUT "Malformed line: ", Line
   ELSE
      Quantity ← TOINTEGER(QuantityText)
      IF Quantity < 5 THEN
         WRITEFILE "LowStock.txt", Code & "," & Description & "," & QuantityText
         LowCount ← LowCount + 1
      ENDIF
   ENDIF
ENDWHILE
CLOSEFILE "Stock.csv"
CLOSEFILE "LowStock.txt"
OUTPUT LowCount
modelAnswer.vi:
DECLARE Line, Code, Description, QuantityText : STRING
DECLARE Quantity, LowCount : INTEGER
LowCount ← 0
OPENFILE "Stock.csv" FOR READ
OPENFILE "LowStock.txt" FOR WRITE
WHILE NOT EOF("Stock.csv")
   READFILE "Stock.csv", Line
   Code ← FIELD(Line, 1)
   Description ← FIELD(Line, 2)
   QuantityText ← FIELD(Line, 3)
   // Hàm TOINTEGER được cung cấp sẽ báo lỗi với dữ liệu sai định dạng.
   IF Code = "" OR Description = "" THEN
      OUTPUT "Dòng sai định dạng: ", Line
   ELSE
      Quantity ← TOINTEGER(QuantityText)
      IF Quantity < 5 THEN
         WRITEFILE "LowStock.txt", Code & "," & Description & "," & QuantityText
         LowCount ← LowCount + 1
      ENDIF
   ENDIF
ENDWHILE
CLOSEFILE "Stock.csv"
CLOSEFILE "LowStock.txt"
OUTPUT LowCount
